summary: Explains win_updates (install multiple updates by category) and win_hotfix (install a single downloaded update; requires DISM cmdlets, default on Server 2012+). Includes examples with conditional reboots via win_reboot.
questions: How do I install Windows security and critical updates with Ansible?
How can I install a single KB hotfix on a Windows server?
How do I reboot only when Windows updates require it?
Why does win_hotfix fail on Windows Server 2008?

answer_card.title: Installing Windows updates and hotfixes
answer_card.answer_md:
- **`win_updates`** installs many updates by category.
- **`win_hotfix`** installs one downloaded update file; it needs the DISM PowerShell cmdlets (default on Server 2012+, install manually on older hosts).

```yaml
- win_updates:
    category_names: [CriticalUpdates, SecurityUpdates]
    state: installed
  register: update_result
- win_reboot:
  when: update_result.reboot_required
```

For a hotfix: download the .msu with `win_get_url`, then `win_hotfix: hotfix_kb: KB3172729, source: <path>, state: present`, and reboot on `hotfix_result.reboot_required`.
